1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with clear heading hierarchy and comfortable line spacing, though the Logs panel is small dense monospace.

2.why: Instructional text is sentence-case with no italics and short blocks, but all-caps appears in the 'NORTHSTAR BANK'/'SECURITY CENTRE' labels and recovery codes, and the Logs block is dense.

3.why: Every screen is a narrow single-column layout with full-width buttons that fits a mobile viewport, though light-gray placeholder text and tiny log text slightly reduce readability.

4.why: Instructions are brief and plain ('Enter the six-digit code generated during setup', 'These codes can help you recover access'), with only the demo notice using mild jargon like 'short-lived challenge'.

5.why: Only some inputs show format examples (phone placeholder '+15551234567', recovery-code placeholder 'ABCD-EFGH-JKLM'); the email, identity code, and authenticator code fields show no example.

6.why: All instructional blocks are two to three lines, though in test mode the required mock code must be found in a Logs panel that grows into a long dense block by step 14.

7.why: The 32-character setup secret and the eight recovery codes are presented with no copy or download control, and the UI explicitly instructs 'Enter it manually in your authenticator app.'

8.why: No QR code or equivalent appears anywhere in the flow; step 5 offers only a manually transcribed secret.

9.why: The screenshots show plain inputs with no password field and no visible autocomplete or one-time-code attributes, so autofill and password-manager support can neither be confirmed nor denied.

10.why: Each screen has a large bold step heading and one dominant full-width blue primary button, though the first screen presents two large buttons and styles 'Verify and continue' as primary even though 'Get a simulation challenge' must come first.

11.why: Most screens request a single action, but the sign-in screen asks for three fields plus two button choices, and the MFA settings screen offers several actions at once.

12.why: Green banners plainly state outcomes at some milestones ('Setup secret generated…', 'Enrolment confirmed…'), but the identity check passing, authenticator verification, and recovery-code acceptance are confirmed only in the Logs panel, not the main UI.

13.why: Back links, a repeatable 'Get a simulation challenge', and 'Generate replacement codes' (used three times in the Logs without lockout) allow retry and re-request, though there is no reveal/hide toggle and replacements permanently invalidate prior codes as disclosed.

14.why: No error message appears in any of the 14 screenshots, so whether errors state the problem and fix without blame cannot be assessed.

15.why: No countdown or reading timer is shown, but the identity challenge is explicitly described as 'short-lived' and authenticator TOTP codes are time-based by design, so generous entry time is not assured.
